title: Structured output change attribution orchestrator
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Goal: Build an orchestration layer that ties structured-output quality deltas to concrete model/config changes and surfaces actionable attributions. Motivation: current monitoring flags schema mismatches and field-level drift but lacks deterministic mapping from a detected anomaly to the set of recent changes (model version, quantization profile, runtime kernel selection, batching params, or prompt-hooking). This ticket scopes the first-phase implementation: (1) ingest change metadata from deploys and config flips, (2) group evals by change windows, (3) compute field-level divergence fingerprints, (4) score candidate causes using temporal and cohort-based heuristics, (5) generate human-readable attributions with confidence, and (6) emit alerts to Console with rollback/fallback recommendations. Primary consumers: SRE/Runtime on-call, product owners managing rollouts, and automated rollback policies in Dedicated/Private. Success criteria: (A) for historical incidents in the test corpus, the orchestrator ranks the true root cause in top-3 for >= 85% of cases, (B) end-to-end pipeline latency for attribution <= 10 minutes after first anomaly, (C) Console playbook contains at least two recommended mitigations per attribution with links to runbooks.
comments: 2026-03-10 Marcus Liang: Kickoff sync happened. Agreed to prototype with existing eval batch outputs and change logs from deployment service. Need API contract for change metadata. Action: Marcus to draft change metadata schema.

2026-03-11 Aisha Khatri: Ran retrospective pairing against 8 prior structured-output regressions. Observations: temporary kernel changes and a single quantization profile flip produced correlated multi-field deviations; prompt template edits created high false positives because of prefix differences. Proposal: introduce weighted heuristics that penalize prompt-shape-only diffs and prioritize infra/model config deltas.

2026-03-12 Riley Chen: Suggested using a 'causal tag vector' per rollout (model_tag, quant_profile, kernel_hash, batch_cfg, prompt_patch_id, runtime_image) to accelerate attribution. Riley will add tag enforcements to the deployment pipeline so every rollout writes a tag vector to the change-log stream.

2026-03-12 Marcus Liang: Drafted initial UI mock for Console: summary card with top-3 candidate causes + confidence, fieldwise delta heatmap, example failing samples, and quick-actions: 'pin prior model', 'enable prefix-cache', 'increase timeout'. Need design input for wording of confidence and rollback suggestions.

2026-03-12 Product (Nina Patel): Please ensure the alert language is non-technical by default and links to a detailed technical view. Also request an opt-in mode for Managed Dedicated customers to allow automated safe fallback under preapproved policies.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: data model and proto (1 week) - define change metadata schema, augment deployment service to emit tags. Phase 2: offline attribution engine (2 weeks) - batch-run candidate scoring against historical incidents and tune heuristics. Phase 3: real-time pipeline (2 weeks) - stream evals + change tags into engine, compute attributions, emit alerts. Phase 4: Console integration & playbooks (1 week) - UI cards and quick actions. Phase 5: canary run on non-critical customers (2 weeks) - measure precision/recall and latency. Deliverables: API spec for change tags, attribution scoring service, Console cards, runbook templates.
observability_requirements: Telemetry: per-sample field diff vector, cohort identifier, deployment tag vector, model config fingerprint, kernel selection fingerprint, timestamp. Retention: 90 days for attribution auditing, 365 days for sampled failing traces. Metrics: attribution_latency_seconds, attribution_top1_accuracy, candidate_confidence_distribution. Logs: structured JSON with candidate scores and top-k causal tags.
runbook_snippet: If attribution confidence > 0.85 and cause == 'quant_profile': 1) notify runtime on-call, 2) trigger automatic fallback to previous quant_profile if within rollback window, 3) mark rollout as paused and create rollback PR. If cause == 'prompt_template_change' and confidence < 0.6: add failing samples to eval set and schedule human review.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy prompt edits produce spurious attributions. Mitigation: incorporate prompt-shape normalization and require co-occurrence across multiple cohorts before flagging. Risk: deployment tags missing or malformed. Mitigation: make tags write-fail visible in deployment CI and fall back to time-based windowing as secondary signal. Risk: overloaded Console with low-value alerts. Mitigation: tune thresholds and provide a digest mode for consolidated alerts.
next_steps: 1) Marcus to publish change metadata schema and PR to deployment repo by 2026-03-15. 2) Riley to add tag emission to canary deployments. 3) Aisha to assemble historical incident corpus and label true causes for offline tuning. 4) Schedule design pass with Console team for language and quick actions (target: 2026-03-18).
